latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of canvas-design-skip skill.
- Enables the creation of original visual art based on bespoke design philosophies, producing .md, .png, and .pdf files.
- Introduces a two-step process: first generating a design philosophy manifesto in .md, then visually expressing it on canvas.
- Emphasizes expert craftsmanship, minimal text, and visually rich artworks, with each element meticulously crafted.
- Guides users to create sophisticated, context-aware art objects—not templates—with subtle conceptual references woven into visual form.
